install_cmds: python -c "import compressai, torch; from compressai.zoo import bmshj2018_hyperprior; print('compressai', compressai.__version__, 'torch', torch.__version__)"

data_deps.name: compressai_kodak
data_deps.description: The 24 standard Kodak PNG images (768x512): the ORIGINAL FIXED train/eval split (kodim01..20 / kodim21..24, used by the 3 original compress-* tasks) PLUS a FIXED 3-way content-complexity split (low/mid/high texture terciles, 6 train + 2 eval images each) under kodak/{low,mid,high}/, used by the newer compress-* architecture-axis tasks so every new task aggregates over >=3 settings. Used by the compress-* learned-image-compression tasks. ~13MB. Deterministic.
